criteria.evidence: All 15 components have a content_* baseline (19 files). I opened statuschip, storybars, listrow_font200, coverage_delta, tag, statusbar, chip_keyword and soonrow. content_statuschip records 'Rejecte/d' broken mid-word at font 1.0, because the sample squeezes 5 chips into a plain Row. content_storybars draws ink bars on the black page, so the baseline is effectively blank (the prototype draws them on a colour card). The others match the prototype's intent.

tmrStatusChipColors equals SS (Prototype.dc.html line 1139): blue/amber outlines, ink on lime and amber, Rejected #A6A6A6 on transparent with a #444 border. Verified against Palette.kt. TmrStatusChipTest asserts all 5 statuses.

segmentColor equals SEGC (line 1279: segOffer #E9E8E4, segRejected #555). tmrStatusBarSegments drops counts of 0 or less. The legend test asserts 'Saved 2' and that Offer is absent. The bar is cleared from semantics and the legend text is read.

strings_content.xml uses only 'Keywords matched'. TmrStringsPolicyTest scans values*/strings*.xml, and the expected key was updated for the core_designsystem_ prefix. Sample labels in tests such as 'Matching 8 keywords' are prototype copy passed in by the caller, not resources.
TmrCoverageDelta shows the 'Keywords matched' label and percent values. TmrCoverageDeltaTest asserts the merged summary 'Keywords matched: 61% now, up to 92% after tailoring'. The baseline matches.

The spinner takes its period from motion.idle.spinnerTurnMs, and rememberInfiniteTransition is skipped when reduced or !spinnerAnimated. Paired tests on TmrSpinnerAnimatedKey (false under Reduced, true under default) fail if the gate is removed. Compose tests cancel infinite transitions, so this internal key is an acceptable test seam. Percent carries progressBarRangeInfo and a plural state. Each row has a Done/In progress/Waiting state description. Gap: pending text uses textDisabled on the surfaceRaised card, which is 4.40:1 (see finding).

The red test required a Text property on the paper node. That contradicted the plan's clearAndSetSemantics. The head assertion (no merged text, one summary starting 'Resume preview.' with 'Keywords matched: 92%') follows the plan and is explained in the PR body. Reviewer A's L (fixed-scale paper text) is accepted per PLAN.md 3.2 'paper* ... (fixed scale)'.

TmrKeywordChip, TmrSourceChip, and the TmrTag enum with a TmrTagChip composable, all labelled from resources. This deviates from the plan's TmrChips.kt::TmrTag naming, but the API is equivalent. The Soon and Required test edits after the red commit match the prototype: Soon is #A6A6A6 on transparent, and the boundary border is per D32. The red values were white on #A6A6A6 and white on amber, both under 3:1. Tag text is not uppercased (see finding).
File card buttons have heightIn(48dp), Role.Button and 'Share <file>'/'Open <file>' descriptions. Each callback is asserted once.

Strings live only in strings_content.xml and composables only in component.content. The legacy component/TmrCard.kt is untouched. At review time the head's Core unit tests, Screenshot tests, Lint, App/Feature unit tests and Assemble APKs were still pending (run 38089754380). Static checks, the constitution check and pregate pass. No local verify-local.sh evidence is recorded.

findings.trigger: A Pending row's label and meta use textDisabled #7D7D7D. They sit on the progress card background surfaceRaised #161616 (line 224), which gives 4.40:1, below 4.5 for 15sp body text. D32 moved textDisabled to #7D7D7D only for #111111 (4.59). TmrPaletteContrastTest checks textDisabled on background only, so this pair is untested. Pending rows are informational status ('Waiting'), not inactive controls, so the WCAG exemption does not apply.
findings.title: Pending progress rows fail 4.5:1 on the raised card
findings.proof: Add a TmrPaletteContrastTest pair ('pending row on raised', textDisabled, surfaceRaised) with the 4.5 threshold. It fails at 4.40.

findings.rule: D40 no mid-word break / 267-c1 baseline inspected
findings.trigger: StatusChips() puts all 5 chips in a non-wrapping Row on the 360dp device. The last chip is squeezed, and content_statuschip_prototype_dark.png records 'Rejecte' / 'd'. The recorded reference baseline approves a D40 violation at font 1.0.
findings.title: Status chip baseline records 'Rejected' broken mid-word
findings.proof: Use FlowRow in StatusChips() and re-record. The baseline then shows 'Rejected' on one line.

findings.rule: 267-c1 each component has a meaningful screenshot
findings.trigger: TmrStoryBars draws colors.ink (#0A0A0A) bars and a 16% ink track. ScreenColumn paints the black background, so content_storybars_prototype_dark.png is almost entirely black, and the active, partial and empty states cannot be inspected. The prototype draws the bars on a colour hero card.
findings.title: Story bars baseline is invisible ink on black
findings.proof: Wrap the sample in a lime or blue card background and re-record. The 3 states then become visible.

findings.rule: D40: a single word that cannot fit shrinks via auto-size to 1x, never breaks
findings.trigger: The new exemption (atBoundary || !wordFitsOnOneLine) passes any text, in any component, whose word is wider than the container and is broken mid-word. D40 asks for auto-size shrink in that case. The coder2 disposition says 'D40 allows no break there', which misreads D40. At 2.0/337dp the file name segment 'Deshmukh_Northwind-' (about 19 chars of 30sp Space Grotesk in about 250dp) breaks inside the token and fileCardStaysInsideAtFontScale200 still passes.
findings.title: D40 guard exempts unfittable words instead of requiring auto-size
findings.proof: Narrow the exemption to the file-name node, or apply auto-size to TmrFileCard's name and drop the exemption. A section label or tag with a long word at 2.0 then fails the guard as D40 intends.

findings.rule: PLAN.md 3.2 type table: label = Space Mono 12, 0.6, uppercase; prototype Soon/Best value/Required use text-transform:uppercase
findings.trigger: TmrTagChip renders stringResource(tag.labelRes) in typography.label without .uppercase(), so the baseline shows 'Soon', 'Best value' and 'Required' rather than SOON, BEST VALUE and REQUIRED. TmrSectionLabel uppercases explicitly, so the omission is inconsistent within this PR. The same applies to the 'Keywords matched' label in TmrCoverageDelta.
findings.title: Tag chips skip the uppercase transform of the label style
